title: B1: Would I do it? with the agency-contract situation, then Say it in my voice (one call covers B2 and B3)
live_drive_args: A former agency client offers me a three-month contract at double my usual rate, but it means pausing my own product work and going back into their office three days a week. Should I take it?
fallback: Budget 60 s: a length retry can run 3 qwen3-8b-8k calls (about 80 s, an estimate, never measured in rehearsal). Keep talking over the spinner; at 60 s narrate the recorded B2.1 output from the DEMO.md Appendix (section 10). Never click B1 twice (the second click queues). If the result shows **Error:**, narrate the Appendix; rerun the prep line before B4 only when the error names a connection or LM Studio (Decide embeds the situation with LM Studio's nomic model). Any other error (for example no valid verdict after the retries) is not fixed by prep: move on. Never expand or scroll the Raw result panel beside the verdict (its chunk list names the 'Expert reflections/Political scientist' lens); if asked, that is a lens name, and politics is not taken live.

title: Say it in my voice (no separate call: timed as the say_it segment of B2.1)
fallback: Say it takes about 9 s while Stheno Q4 swaps in for qwen3-8b-8k in LM Studio (9.4 s in run 1, 9.1 s in run 2, 8.9 s in run 8, 7.8 s in run 12). If 'In my voice' is still empty after 20 s, skip it, read the say_it line of B2.1 from the DEMO.md Appendix and go to Ask (its tab pre-warm loads Stheno anyway).

title: Click Ask and wait for 'Pre-warmed stheno_q4' (rehearsed as /warm ask)
fallback: Wait for the note before Send. If the pre-warm fails, LM Studio is probably down: rerun the prep line (DEMO.md section 8 LM Studio row), then click the Status tab and then Ask again (clicking the tab you are already on sends no select event, so nothing re-warms), and wait for its note. No note after 30 s means an earlier call (for example a hung Say it) still holds the gpu queue: follow the DEMO.md section 8 hang row, then select Ask again. If it still fails, show the recorded B4.1 reply and trace from the DEMO.md Appendix (section 10).

title: Condition interview: first question, then open Trace (a reply that reaches the 300-token cap is trimmed to its last full sentence when a safe cut exists, and the trace says so)
live_drive_args: What did you learn from quitting the agency job?
fallback: Explain the trace while it streams. No reply after 45 s: open Status, click Free GPU (if that click only queues, run scripts\free_gpu.ps1 in the prep window), select Ask again and wait for its note, click Clear (otherwise the failed turn and its error text stay in the chat, so the resend carries a 2-turn history and adds a rewrite step), paste the question again and click Send once. Fails again: show the recorded B4.1 reply and trace from the DEMO.md Appendix (section 10).

title: Follow-up in the same chat: the rewrite step appears in Trace (presenter may skip when behind time)
fallback: Say the rewrite model (llama3.2:3b) is loading while it runs. Nothing after 45 s (measured 15-17 s) means it is hung: Clear cancels nothing and B4.4's Send would queue behind it on the gpu queue. Open Status and click Free GPU (if that click only queues, run scripts\free_gpu.ps1 in the prep window, DEMO.md section 8 hang row), select Ask and wait for its note, click Clear and go to B4.4. Rehearsal: needs scripts/dev/demo/ask_interview.json from B4.1, so run B4.1 first when selecting steps with --only.

live_drive_args: What's your exact income this year? Give me the real number.
fallback: Not asked live. Boundary deflection is a prompt-level rule (twin/prompts.py:55-56) at the Ask temperature of 1.0, not a filter: it held 1 of 2 in rehearsal (run 2 answered 'in the 40s thousands this year', scripts/dev/demo/run2_B4.3.txt) and 3 of 3 in the cached interview-condition probe run (data/eval_results.json, local qwen2.5 judge). Show the Eval tab's Boundary probes table instead (B7.1) and state that limit plainly. If an audience member asks for the income question live, decline. Rehearsal with --include-optional or --only B4.3: expect checks only the trace markers and a non-empty reply; judge the deflection by reading run<N>_B4.3.txt.

fallback: Never click. It rewrites data/items/scores.json with a new updated stamp (twin/ui/items.py:233-239, 273-276), which changes the file's SHA-256 and fails the rehearsal hash check.

fallback: Never click. It runs the twin over the item bank with four big models (all three conditions: 447 model calls in 15 min 16 s, docs/EVIDENCE2.md row 3.1) and rewrites data/items/twin_answers.json and scores.json.

title: Eval: the cached voice, retrieval and Boundary probes tables (already filled when the tab opens; Refresh is optional); state the boundary limit plainly
fallback: No model (cached). The tables are already filled when the tab opens, so Refresh is optional; if clicked, use the outlined Refresh at the left of its row (below the fold, under the Boundary probes table), never the ochre-outlined 'Re-run voice bake-off (~6 min)' or 'Re-run retrieval bake-off' at the right end of the same row. Never use scripts/dev/evidence/stage5_eval_show.py as a replay check: it also calls /items_score, which rewrites data/items/scores.json.

fallback: File reads only. If the audit table looks stale, click 'Refresh audit tail' once more. Off-screen check of the real endpoint: python scripts/dev/evidence/stage2_audit_tail.py <port> scripts/dev/demo/audit_tail.json (reads /audit_tail, writes only that JSON).

title: Status: Free GPU (GPU back to idle)
fallback: Free GPU is the first control of its row and the only filled brown button on the tab; the 'Tab to warm' dropdown, Warm current tab and a plain Refresh sit beside it, and the ochre-outlined 'Rebuild index + digest' and 'Rebuild digest (force, qwen3:8b)' are on the row directly below, so click only Free GPU. The 'Last action' line appears at the top of the status readout and the 5 s refresh clears it within seconds, so judge by the sidebar GPU MiB. If a failure line appears, nothing happens (the click queued behind a hung call), or the nvidia-smi line stays above 200 MiB, run powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\free_gpu.ps1 in the prep window. Never stop processes by name.
